Trial Network Architecture
3-Site Fixed Wireless Access Trial Network Architecture
Slide 02 / 07

Trial Radio Access Network (RAN)

  • 3 gNodeB Base Stations: Dolores (Mabalacat), Reliance IT Center (Angeles City), and Comclark NOC (Pasig).
  • Antenna Elevation & Transmit Power: 30-meter structural elevation, 20W ERP on Band n50, 40W ERP on Band n77.
  • Sector Configuration: 3 sectors per site (120° beamwidth, azimuths at 0°, 120°, 240°).

Dual-Band Empirical Evaluation

  • Band n50 (1432–1517 MHz, 80 MHz): Evaluated for extended rural/suburban coverage radius (~3.5 km) and building penetration.
  • Band n77 (3700–3800 MHz, 100 MHz): Benchmarked for ultra-high throughput capacity in dense clusters.
  • Direct Comparison: Path loss, indoor attenuation, and MCS stability across identical propagation vectors.

Backhaul & Core Transport

  • Primary Backhaul: Dedicated Comclark optical fiber backbone handoff.
  • Alternate / Redundant Backhaul: Starlink Business LEO Satellite link (220+ Mbps DL, 28–45 ms latency).
  • 5G Core Testbed: Localized 5G Core control and user plane testbed at Reliance IT Center.

Trial Methodology
Propagation Trial Methodology & Testing Framework
Slide 06 / 07

5-Phase Empirical Testing Framework:

A rigorous 30-day technical testing plan executing structured drive tests, indoor penetration measurements, and backhaul stress tests across Mabalacat and Angeles City.

👉 Swipe table horizontally to see full columns

Detailed Testing Schedule & Procedures:

Testing Phase Methodology & Test Procedures Expected Technical Deliverables Execution Team
1. Radio Verification Verify antenna azimuths (0°/120°/240°), 30m height, transmit power (20W n50 / 40W n77), and fiber links. Compliance with NTC technical conditions and authorized emissions (60M0F9W & 100M0F9W). Lead RF Engineer
2. Propagation Drive Tests Drive testing along radial routes in Mabalacat and Angeles to measure RSRP, SINR, and signal decay curves. Document empirical coverage radius on 1.5 GHz Band n50 and 3.7 GHz Band n77. Drive Test Team
3. Building Penetration Test indoor signal reception and throughput using test UEs and indoor CPEs inside residential CHB structures. Measure indoor path loss and determine viable CPE antenna configurations. CPE Solutions Team
4. Core & Traffic Benchmarking Execute test traffic and KPI capture through the Reliance IT Center 5G Core testbed. Record round-trip latency, user plane packet handling, and session stability. Core & Transport Team
5. NTC Demonstration Report Compile trial test data, coverage maps, and technical findings into formal report for NTC submission. Fulfill permit reporting requirements under NTC rules. Regulatory Lead
Risk Assessment
Technical & Operational Risk Assessment Matrix
Slide 07 / 07
👉 Swipe table horizontally to see full columns

Identified Risks, Severity & Mitigation Strategy:

Risk Category Risk Description Severity Likelihood Mitigation Strategy & Action Plan
Co-Channel Interference Interference with adjacent services or legacy deployments in 1.5 GHz or 3.7 GHz. High Low Conduct pre-broadcast spectrum sweep; verify steep filter skirts on bandpass filters.
Building Penetration Loss Excessive signal attenuation through dense concrete and metal residential structures. Medium Medium Compare indoor vs outdoor CPE form factors; evaluate window-mounted antennas and high-gain CPEs.
Satellite Backhaul Fade Tropical monsoon downpours degrading Starlink satellite backhaul links. Medium Low Implement Starlink High-Performance hardware; configure local QoS queues and adaptive coding.
Permit Timing & Scope Expiration of 90-day trial testing authority before full drive tests conclude. High Low Strictly adhere to 30-day testing window; file for permit extension if required by weather delays.
